<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperates initially, then mirrors the opponent’s most recent action. This maintains mutual cooperation with cooperative opponents while responding immediately to defection without permanently locking into retaliation after a single adverse round.
</DESCRIPTION>

    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else opponent_history[-1]
